environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service behind an ALB with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rule group (priority 1) with a rule that inspects POST requests to paths matching '/api/admin/*' and blocks requests where the 'Origin' header value does not match the regex pattern '^https://admin\.internal\.corp\.example\.com$' OR where the 'Referer' header is absent/does not match the same pattern. The rule uses an AND condition: (1) ByteMatchStatement on URI path '/api/admin/' with PositionalConstraint STARTS_WITH, (2) NOT RegexMatchStatement on Origin header, (3) HTTP method is POST. Action is BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, a second rule (priority 2) references the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with CrossSiteScripting_BODY and SizeRestrictions_BODY set to COUNT mode (not block). The ALB also has a listener rule that requires the custom header 'X-Internal-Request-ID' to be present (forwarded by the corporate reverse proxy), but this header check is implemented as a fixed-response 403 if missing — however, this particular listener rule only applies to the '/api/admin/batch' path, NOT '/api/admin/enqueue'.
